data.name: Iqwaan
data.gender_notes: Iqwaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Iqwaan is a name derived from the Arabic word 'iqwa', meaning 'to support' or 'to be firm'. It signifies a person who is steadfast and unwavering in their beliefs and actions, always standing strong in the face of adversity. This name holds great significance in Islamic culture as a reminder of the importance of patience, resilience, and unwavering faith.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unwavering faith and steadfastness
data.etymology: Iqwaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Steadfast, Strong, Vigorous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iqwaan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: إقوان
in_arabic.meaning: إقوان تعني الإخاء و المودة و الحب
in_arabic.long_meaning: إقوان هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ق-و-ن' الذي يدل على الإستقامة و التوافق. يرمز الاسم إلى الإخاء و المودة و الحب بين الناس، و هو قيمة مهمة في الإسلام. كما أن للإقوان دلالة على التآلف و الت团结، مما يعزز الروابط الإجتماعية و يعزز الشعور بالإنتماء للمجتمع.

in_urdu.name: اقوان
in_urdu.meaning: اقوان مطلب ہے بھائی چارہ، محبت اور پیار
in_urdu.long_meaning: اقوان ایک عربی نام ہے جو جڑ 'ق-و-ن' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا تعلق ہے سیدھے رہنے اور ہم آہنگی کے ساتھ۔ یہ نام بھائی چارے، محبت اور پیار کی علامت ہے، جو اسلامی اقدار میں بہت اہم ہیں۔ اقوان نام کے معنیٰ میں بھی الفت و اتحاد کا مضمر ہے، جو سماجی روابط کو مضبوط بناتا ہے اور اجتماعی احساس کو بڑھاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इक़वान
in_hindi.meaning: इक़वान का अर्थ है भाईचारा, प्रेम और स्नेह
in_hindi.long_meaning: इक़वान एक अरबी नाम है जो 'क़-व-न' जड़ से निकला है, जो सीधे रहने और सामंजस्य की भावना को दर्शाता है। यह नाम भाईचारे, प्रेम और स्नेह का प्रतीक है, जो इस्लामी मूल्यों में अत्यंत महत्वपूर्ण हैं। इक़वान नाम के अर्थ में भी एकता और संघ की भावना समाहित है, जो सामाजिक संबंधों को मजबूत बनाती है और समुदाय में एकता की भावना को बढ़ाती है।

in_pashto.name: اقوان
in_pashto.meaning: اقوان دى ورتهولي، مينې او مودې
in_pashto.long_meaning: اقوان د عربي نوم څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کوم چې د 'ق-و-ن' ريښې څخه جوړ شوی دی، دا د سيدو پاتې کيدو او همغږۍ په معنا ده. دا نوم د وروڼوالي، مينې او مودې دى نښه ده، کوم چې په اسلام کې ډېر مهم دي. اقوان نوم د الفت او يوالي په معنا کې هم کارول شوی دی، کوم چې ټولنيز اړيکې پياوړې کوي او ټولنې د يوې ټولې کورنۍ په توګه احساس کوي.

in_english.name: Iqwaan
in_english.meaning: Iqwaan means brotherhood, love, and affection in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Iqwaan is an Arabic name derived from the root 'q-w-n', which signifies uprightness and harmony. The name embodies the values of brotherhood, love, and affection, which are pivotal in Islam. It connotes unity and togetherness, strengthening social bonds and fostering a sense of community. Historically, the term 'Iqwan' or 'Ikwan' has been used in various Islamic contexts to denote groups or movements that emphasize unity and cooperation among Muslims.

historical_references.reference: Iqwaan al-Maisouri was a Berber leader from the Maghreb who revolted against the Umayyad Caliphate in 739 AD. He was a Zanata Berber, and led a rebellion against the Arab rulers who had taken control of North Africa. Iqwaan's revolt was based on a combination of religious and tribal grievances, and he was able to gain the support of both Berber tribes and Islamic scholars. He was eventually defeated by a joint Arab and Byzantine force.
historical_references.context: Berber rebellion against Umayyad Caliphate in North Africa

historical_references.reference: Iqwaan al-Masri was an Egyptian scholar and preacher who lived during the Mamluk Sultanate in the 14th century. He was known for his fiery sermons and his opposition to the corrupt Mamluk rulers. Iqwaan was a prominent figure in the Sufi tradition, and his teachings emphasized the importance of spiritual purity and the dangers of worldly wealth and power. He was executed by the Mamluks for his outspoken criticisms of their rule.
historical_references.context: Egyptian scholar and preacher who opposed Mamluk rulers
